 Arcanxo Festival 
 Arcanxo Festival 2027: Rotting Christ and Crisix lead the first line-up announcement for the Ponteareas metal festival, on 16 and 17 July
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 21 Nov 2026, 11:00 
 A 2-minute read 
 Stéphane Gallay / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Rotting Christ and Crisix head the first line-up announcement for Arcanxo Festival 2027 , alongside The Night Eternal, Wings Of Steel, Barbarian Prophecies, Radity and Music In Low Frequencies: seven bands, half the line-up according to the organisers. 
 The festival will take place on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 July 2027 at A Freixa, in Ponteareas (Pontevedra), on a single stage; according to the ticketing page, doors open at 18:00. 
 Two-day passes are already on sale from €49.95 , with the option of buying one together with a T-shirt; day tickets have not yet been priced. 
 It is one more metal event in the Galician summer , with stage times, camping and rules for under-18s still to be announced. 
 Metal has a new date in Galicia. Arcanxo Festival has revealed the first names for its 2027 edition, which will take place on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 July at A Freixa, in Ponteareas . Greece's Rotting Christ and Catalan band Crisix lead a line-up of seven bands, and two-day passes are already on sale from €49.95 .
 Festival guide 
 Arcanxo Festival 2027 
 16–17 Jul 2027 · A Freixa, Ponteareas 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Arcanxo Festival 2027 line-up: the first seven bands
 The official website presents this announcement as 50% of the line-up. These are the confirmed bands, with their origin:
 Rotting Christ (Greece), one of the veteran names of European black metal.
 Crisix (Catalonia), thrash metal.
 The Night Eternal (Germany).
 Wings Of Steel (United States).
 Barbarian Prophecies (Galicia).
 Radity (Catalonia).
 Music In Low Frequencies (Portugal).
 According to Metalcry, which published the announcement on 20 November, this is the festival's fourth edition , and the organisers promise more confirmations. It is run by 138 Producións, ITP Promotions and We Play Metal.
 Rotting Christ in concert in Geneva in 2019. Image: Stéphane Gallay / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0). Dates and venue: 16 and 17 July at A Freixa
 The official website, the ticketing page and the announcement all agree on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 July 2027 . The poster being shared by the organisers shows different dates, the 17th and 18th, which do not match the ticket sales, where the pass is for the 16th and 17th. Until the festival clarifies this, the dates on the ticketing page are the ones to go by when buying.
 The site is at A Freixa , the river beach area of Ponteareas, and will have a single stage. The ticketing page sets doors at 18:00 and the start at 18:30 . The running order, camping and entry rules for under-18s are still listed as "more information soon" on the website.
 Tickets: passes from €49.95
 Sales are handled by 138 Producións through Musikaze, linked from the festival's tickets page . The two-day pass costs from €49.95 and can be bought as a bundle with a T-shirt. Single-day tickets, for Friday or Saturday, are listed as "coming soon", with no price.
 The website does not say whether the €49.95 includes booking fees, so the final amount will be shown at checkout.
 One more metal festival in the Galician summer
 Arcanxo joins a 2027 Galician calendar that we have already covered in our guide to festivals in Galicia , with Viveiro's Resurrection Fest as the genre's major reference point. Crisix are also on the Resurrection Fest 2027 line-up , so anyone who cannot make it to Viveiro will have another chance to see them in Galicia that summer. All the practical information on Arcanxo will go on its festival page .
 Sources: official Arcanxo Festival website and Musikaze ticketing page, consulted on 21 November 2026; Metalcry (20 November 2026).
